topics.topic: ProofResult identity and dependence on mutable proof context
questions: What identifies a ProofResult when the same flow version can produce different proof results at different times?
What current external facts are part of a ProofResult's meaning or identity, so that two proofs of the same unchanged flow version may legitimately differ?
Is a ProofResult identified only by `flow_version_id`, or must it also identify the mutable proof context under which the result was computed?

quotes: Substitution: proving the same version gives the same result. Continuity: none.
judgement.why: The change did not touch ProofResult or make its dependence on mutable proof context newly relevant.

topics.topic: Effect of trial-corpus growth on an existing function activation
questions: What happens to a contract version's current activation when its trial corpus grows and the activated implementation has no admitted verdict over the new corpus?
When a trial case is added after an implementation was admitted and activated, what happens to that activation now that its verdict no longer covers the current corpus?

quotes: The current activation of a contract version is the one recorded last; the store has one writer (K-17), so records have one order.
judgement.why: The change did not touch activation or trial-corpus growth and did not make their interaction matter differently.

topics.topic: Inspection contents and scope of access to implementation source and related models
questions: Exactly which State 1 models and facts are returned by each inspectable product object, including whether function inspection exposes contracts, implementation code, activations, trial cases, trial executions and verdicts, and whether flow inspection exposes versions, proofs and activations?
May an owner or agent inspect arbitrary implementation source, or is source readable only for the current implementation of a slot selected for repair?

quotes: Read by trial, admission and the sandbox; shown to the agent repairing its slot.
judgement.why: The change did not touch inspection permissions or implementation-source access and did not make their scope newly relevant.

topics.topic: MCP operations exposing omitted primary actions
questions: Are the omitted primary actions exposed over MCP, and if so are they distinct operations or sub-actions of one of the listed operations?
Which MCP product operation exposes each primary action omitted from K-11's asserted fixed set?

quotes:
The kernel exposes one fixed set of typed operations over `mcp`: inspect,
author, try, run, resume, read traces, and the owner's approve, accept, activate,
grant, revoke, resolve and cancel.
judgement.why: The change did not touch the MCP surface or any mapping of primary actions onto it.

topics.topic: Whether NodeExecution is a value or an identity-bearing issued attempt
questions: Is a NodeExecution a value identified by all of its facts, or an entity representing one issued attempt and identified by run_id, node_id, map_index and attempt_number?
Is NodeExecution a value interchangeable by equal facts, or an entity representing one issued observation?

quotes:
### Identity

value

### Identity evidence

Substitution: an attempt's record is issued once. Continuity: none; a further
attempt is a further record.
judgement.why: The change did not alter NodeExecution's identity declaration or make its value-versus-entity classification newly consequential.

topics.topic: AdmissionVerdict behavior and identity on repeated admission
questions: When the same implementation is admitted again against an unchanged corpus, is the existing AdmissionVerdict reused, or is a new verdict created from new TrialExecutions; if new, what distinguishes its identity?

topics.topic: Definition of recent traces and trial evidence supplied for repair
questions: Which traces and trial evidence count as `recent` and are therefore returned to the repairing agent?

topics.topic: Durable approval-preview facts retained after payload bytes are removed
questions: When an approved operation has a file input or another payload whose bytes are removed with the run spool, what durable facts does the approval preview retain?

topics.topic: Eligibility for capturing failed executions after refused or cancelled runs
questions: Can a failed function execution be captured after its run ends refused or cancelled, and does eligibility differ between cases containing only stored values and cases requiring spooled file inputs?

topics.topic: Target and persistence semantics of the try implementation action
questions: What implementation does the separate `try` action operate on, and does it create or persist an Implementation before admission?

topics.topic: Treatment of credential-bearing headers in approval request facts and digests
questions: Are credential-bearing headers excluded from the request facts and digest covered by an approval, and if so which representation of those headers is included?

topics.topic: Whether TrialExecution file outputs record disclosure class
questions: Does each file output recorded by a TrialExecution also carry its disclosure class?

topics.topic: Whether constants are valid flow constructs and how they are classified
questions: Are constants a permitted fourth flow construct, a kind of one of the three stated forms, or not part of flows?

topics.topic: Whether read-only flow versions may be activated by an agent
questions: May an agent invoke the flow-activation action for a proven read-only version?
